objective: Test whether a direction-preserving soft radial budget can retain the classification benefit of the wide unbounded age residual while approaching the probability quality of the bounded coordinate-wise residual.

relationship.known_results: IDEA-072 found that U1 had the highest mean Macro-F1 and was positive against A0 on all three base seeds, while C1 had the best mean Brier and better CE than U1.
relationship.scope: New-seed internal module screening on the same 111 cats and role system; not independent-dataset confirmation.
relationship.positive_subthreshold_retention: A0, U1, and C1 are all retained and rerun because the preceding experiment showed complementary classification and calibration advantages.

pipeline_definitions.U1_wide_unbounded_additive: IDEA-072 capacity-matched unbounded 20->60->128 additive age residual.
pipeline_definitions.S1_soft_radial_budget: New 20->60->128 residual r=u*B/(B+||u||), with B=0.25*stopgrad(sqrt(sum(h^2)+128*eps)); norms and scaling are computed in FP32 with autocast disabled, followed by a one-dtype-epsilon downward guard before casting to the hidden dtype.

model.seed_derivation_rule: Read successive non-overlapping digest uint32 values in big-endian order, reduce modulo 10000, skip a value only if it collides with any already used IDEA-068 through IDEA-072 base seed, and stop after three unique values. No collision occurred in the first three values.
model.initialization_fairness: All three 20->60->128 age-output layers are zero-initialized. U1, C1, and S1 state_dict tensors must match exactly, and all four pre-optimization logits must match exactly. Training RNG is reset after model construction.
model.mechanism_attribution: S1 differs from U1 only by a smooth global L2 budget, and from C1 only by the global direction-preserving radial transform versus coordinate-wise tanh.

fixed_training.ast_head: training-role standardized 768 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm, and dropout

aggregation.primary_metric_unit: Nine seed-by-repeat estimates, each pooling four validation folds, weighted equally.
aggregation.calibration_gate_unit: Nine seed-by-repeat cross-entropy and Brier estimates, weighted equally.
aggregation.split_cell_unit: Twelve repeat-by-fold cells, each first averaged across three base seeds.
aggregation.descriptive_only: Thirty-six fold comparisons and 612 repeated animal occurrences per pipeline are descriptive and are not treated as independent observations.

gate.pass_action: Freeze S1 as the direction-preserving bounded age-residual candidate before external-dataset and AST-depth testing.
gate.partial_pass_action: Retain and report each successful tier separately; U1 and C1 remain valid complementary candidates when S1 does not combine both advantages.
gate.fail_action: Report all positive and negative outcomes without changing the formula, cap, width, seeds, aggregation, tolerances, or gates on this result.
